meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调出过往对话里与目标相关的记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常开多个会话，想搜回过往聊过的人、事或结论，免去重复询问。
copy.tagline_en: Pull up relevant records from your past conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run many sessions and want to recall people, tasks, or conclusions from past chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会去查你在 Claude-Mem(cmem.ai)里的持久记忆,用关键词搜索过去会话留下的观察记录,再提炼成平实回答;先宽泛检索、再收窄,不把原始搜索结果直接倒给你。
howto.when: 当你提到「search memory」「你还记得 X 吗」「上次会话我们做了什么」等说法,或需要某个项目、决策、文件、任务的过往上下文时触发。

say.text: 搜一下记忆里关于这个项目的记录
say.note: 会运行 cmem 搜索并汇总相关观察

say.text: 上次会话我们对这个文件做了什么改动
say.note: 会按时间线返回相关观察与时间戳

say.text: 检查一下 claude-mem 的状态
say.note: 会运行 status 并如实报告结果

howto.what_en: After install, Claude searches your persistent Claude-Mem memory (cmem.ai) by keyword, then synthesizes plain-language answers from past-session observations; it narrows broad searches rather than dumping raw output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "what did we do last session", etc., or need prior-session context on a project, decision, file, or task.

say_en.text: Search my memory for notes about this project
say_en.note: Runs the cmem search and summarizes observations

say_en.text: What did we do to this file last session

say_en.note: Runs status and reports it plainly
